brief:
**Week 3 recap:** you won and moved to **2-1, 2nd in total points (397.8)**, just 1.3 behind Big D. Seeding is by total points, so you're in great shape.

**Week 4:** you face **Sam Roush disliker** (2-1, 343.7 PF). ESPN projects **122.3 to 128.7**, a **47%** win chance. Their core: Ja'Marr Chase, Derrick Henry, Aaron Jones, Garrett Wilson, DJ Moore, Jared Goff.

### Your players
- **Nico Collins (WR, HOU) vs DAL, questionable.** ESPN's Adam Schefter reports a *decent chance* he returns (NBC Sports), and CBS/RotoWire say coach DeMeco Ryans is hopeful. Dallas allows 27.3 points per game and 7 passing TDs (ESPN). If he plays, he's a WR1 again.
- **Drake London & Bijan Robinson (ATL) at NO, Monday night.** London went 9-194 on 10 targets with Penix back; Bijan scored 35.3. Both keep top-tier outlooks (ESPN).
- **Jalen Hurts (QB, PHI) vs LAR.** He was briefly checked for a concussion after a hit in the Week 3 loss to Chicago but returned quickly and avoided a major injury (Philadelphia Inquirer). Eagles are also without TE Dallas Goedert and WR Hollywood Brown, which concentrates targets but weakens the offense.
- **Jordan Addison (WR, MIN) vs MIA.** 5-90-1 on 9 targets after Justin Jefferson left Week 3 with an ankle sprain. Imaging was good and Jefferson may play Sunday (FantasyPros, via Ian Rapoport). Addison's value drops if Jefferson is active.
- **D'Andre Swift (RB, CHI) vs NYJ.** Season-high 20 carries last week (ESPN).
- **Tyler Warren (TE, IND) vs WSH in London.** Catches have risen every week (9 last week); Washington allows the most QB points (NFL.com). **Kicks off 6:30am PT Sunday.**
- **DK Metcalf (WR, PIT) at CLE, Thursday.** Only 11-98-1 on 24 targets through three games (ESPN).
- **Dalton Kincaid (TE, BUF).** Just 2-38 in Week 3 as DJ Moore returned; Buffalo stays run-heavy (ESPN).
- **Keon Coleman (WR, BUF).** Limited role with Moore healthy, plus an ankle injury (ESPN). The pickup didn't pan out.

### Opponent notes
- **Braelon Allen** (bench) likely starts with Breece Hall week to week (NFL.com), which raises their projection.
- **Rico Dowdle** is in their IR slot, out again (ESPN).
- **DJ Moore** in their FLEX plays the Patriots, who have 8 giveaways.

### Not yet verified
Wednesday–Friday practice reports (Collins, Jefferson), Vegas lines, weather. Refresh Friday.

### The key call: bench Metcalf
Metcalf plays **Thursday**, before Collins' and Jefferson's statuses are known. He's also your lowest-projected WR option. Bench him Thursday; that keeps Collins, Addison and Kincaid open for Sunday.

### Close calls
- **Collins active:** start Collins + London at WR, Addison at FLEX, bench Kincaid.
- **Collins out, Jefferson out:** Addison at WR, Kincaid at FLEX.
- **Collins out, Jefferson active:** Addison at WR (11.5 still edges Kincaid), Kincaid FLEX.

### Re-check before kickoff (Pacific time)
- **Thursday before 5:15pm:** set D/ST (Steelers) and bench Metcalf.
- **Friday afternoon:** Houston and Minnesota final injury reports (Collins, Jefferson).
- **Sunday 5:00am:** Warren/London game inactives.
- **Sunday ~8:30am:** inactives for 10am games (Collins, Swift, Hurts).
- **Sunday ~11:30am:** Jefferson inactive status (Vikings kick at 1:05pm).

You have **$490 FAAB** left and 9th waiver priority. Every player below is confirmed available in your league.

| Priority | Add | Why | FAAB bid | Drop |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **Ollie Gordon II** (RB, MIA) | De'Von Achane is out for the season with a torn ACL; Gordon scored a goal-line TD in relief (NFL.com). Shares the job with Jaylen Wright, who's banged up. Upgrade over Rachaad White and insurance for Swift. | **$45–60** | T.J. Hockenson |
| 2 | **Kalif Raymond** (WR, CHI) | 6-90-1 Monday, 23.1% target share (NFL.com). Replaces a WR who hasn't earned volume. | $5–10 | Keon Coleman |
| 3 | **Mack Hollins** (WR, NE) | A.J. Brown out into mid-October; 19.5% target share (NFL.com). Short-term only. | $1–3 | Only if you skip Raymond |

### Why bid real money on Gordon
Starting-caliber RBs rarely hit waivers after Week 3, and several teams have big budgets left (Torn Ligament Elite has spent only $130, most have spent under $90). You still keep $430+ for later.

### Hold
- **Nico Collins:** likely back this week.
- **Brian Robinson Jr.:** scored last week; Bijan's handcuff.
- **Cam Ward:** only backup QB, needed for Hurts's bye.

### Streaming note
**Bills D/ST** (Patriots have 8 giveaways, 9 sacks allowed) is available, but ESPN projects your Steelers higher this week. Not worth a roster spot.

### Swing players
- **Nico Collins:** if he plays, ESPN's 15.3 projection (discounted for injury risk) likely undersells him against Dallas. He's the biggest lever you have.
- **Jordan Addison vs. Justin Jefferson:** Addison's value hinges on Jefferson sitting.
- **Their Braelon Allen:** if Breece Hall sits, they likely start Allen, adding points to their side.

### Moves that raise your odds
1. **Bench Metcalf Thursday** so you can use Collins or Addison Sunday.
2. **Win Ollie Gordon II** — not a Week 4 starter for you, but the best long-term add available.
